name: SN 2021jag field (Hubble)
blurb: The field of the transient SN 2021jag, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2021jagfield-hubble
story: Hubble took a snapshot of the place where SN 2021jag appeared, one of 75 recent, well-observed transients it revisited to measure how brightly each still glowed long after the explosion and to probe its surroundings.

claims.text: SN2021JAG is a target of Hubble program 16691, Snapshot Observations of Nearby, Recent Transients and Their Environments
The program observes a sample of 75 recent, well-observed transients
The late-time images reveal the transients' late-time luminosity and probe their environments
